evidence.method: Production synthetic API checks and source/unit tests
evidence.observation: New intent-v2.1 runtime returned Rhode Lip Tint for the registered ad in 9.03 seconds. No consent records nothing; foreign origin 403; forged account ticket 401; synthetic visitor history removed. 92 growth tests passed. Control candidate history and account arm assignment fixed; pre-fix data must not support causal uplift.

evidence.source_label: Windsor facebook connector, Sofies Home account; read-only ad configuration and Shopify inventory metadata
evidence.observation: Four ads retain sf_ad={{ad.id}}. Three ACTIVE; perfume PENDING_REVIEW. Lip Tint ad says all shades available. Primary product has 8/9 positive-stock options; ninth has inventoryPolicy CONTINUE, so purchase availability is possible but readiness needs qualification. Active automatic 5% discount exists; applicability conditions not fully verified.

findings.title: Generic descriptions on sampled rewards and policy pages
findings.remediation: Write purpose-specific descriptions without changing existing product descriptions.
findings.validation: Fetch those three pages again and verify distinct accurate meta descriptions.

findings.title: Verify readiness wording and exclusivity claims in current ads
findings.remediation: Clarify available-to-order versus ready stock for the zero-stock CONTINUE option; verify exclusive first-drop evidence and 5% offer conditions before changing ad copy. No ads changed during this audit.
findings.validation: Check exact shade online availability/delivery promise and discount eligibility in an authorized cart preview; obtain substantiation for exclusivity.

findings.title: Measure recommendation loading latency across representative sessions
findings.remediation: Collect cold/warm mobile and desktop traces, then optimize sequential candidate/stock/fallback reads if the delay reproduces. One backend sample is not field CWV.
findings.validation: Record median and p95 API/render latency with device/network settings; verify relevance, consent and stock guardrails after changes.
